corrections.why: On tnlandforms, BLL-nnn is a code for coordinates the GFC supplied and gfc-nnn is a number from an older GFC list. Neither is a register listing, and the page names no register entry for this tower.

notes_for_editor: Thinnest case in the batch: one source, the tnlandforms table and its code notes. Two web searches, the cached NHLR Georgia index, the FFLA cache and the tnlandforms cache found no build, staffing, fate or present-site record. The story says so only where the list itself is silent. The name 'ringgold' is the list author's label, not a historic name. Proposed correction: the BLL and gfc codes are location references, not register numbers. Unverified lead: the FFLA Georgia/SC chapter report for 2013 (https://firelookout.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/cr-rp-gasc-2013.pdf) says Ron Stafford was compiling a Georgia tower status list; that list was not found. Recommend holding this entry as list-only until a Georgia source is found.
